entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit, your partner in performance. To check on an existing order or start a return, press 1. For product questions, press 2.
Thanks for calling VeloFit. My name is Alex. How can I help you today?
Hi Alex, I'm calling about a return. I sent back some cycling shoes and a set of tires a few days ago and wanted to check on the status of my refund.
I can definitely look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yep, it's VF8675309.
Great, thank you. One moment... Okay, I see the order. And I see our warehouse received your return package yesterday. However, it looks like the return was flagged by our inspection team.
Flagged? What does that mean? Is there a problem?
According to the notes here, the items returned show clear signs of use. The report on the shoes mentions very distinct **cleat marks** on the soles. It states they were fully **mounted**.
Well, yeah, of course. I had to install my cleats to see how they felt on the bike. How else am I supposed to test them?

I understand your perspective, but our return policy states that items must be in new, unused condition. Once a cleat has been **installed**, the shoe is considered used. The notes also mention the tires you returned.
What about the tires? I barely rode on them!

The inspection team noted that they had been mounted on rims and have residue on the tread, indicating they are now **dirty tires** from being ridden outside. Because both items are in used condition, I'm afraid I can't approve a refund.
Are you kidding me?! That is completely unacceptable! So I'm just supposed to be out over two hundred dollars for gear that doesn't work for me? This is ridiculous!

I do apologize for the frustration, and I understand this isn't the news you wanted to hear. The physical condition policy is something I cannot override. However, I can see you've been a loyal VeloFit customer for several years, and we truly value your business.
A lot of good that does me now.
I do want to find a solution for you. While I can't process a cash refund, what I can do is offer you the full purchase price for both the shoes and tires as a store credit to your VeloFit account.
Store credit... I don't know.

And to apologize for the inconvenience and the misunderstanding about our policy, I'd also like to add an additional $25 credit to your account. You could use that total amount to find a different set of shoes or tires that will be a perfect fit.
So... you're saying I'd get the full value back in credit, plus an extra twenty-five dollars?
That's correct. It would be available for you to use immediately.
Wow. Okay. That's... actually a really good solution. I can definitely find something else on your site. Thank you, I appreciate you working with me on this.
I'm very glad we could find a resolution for you. I've just applied that full credit to your account now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help. Thanks again, Alex.
You are very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
